epoch_window_open.meaning: the epoch window is open when the keeper submits checkpoint()

last_donation_block_number.meaning: block number of the most recent successful service donation, updated by every successful donation

checkpoint_block_number.meaning: block number in which checkpoint() is mined

checkpoint_reverted.meaning: checkpoint() reverted with SameBlockNumberViolation() instead of finalizing the epoch

assumptions: The attacker can submit a donation transaction with higher priority than the keeper's checkpoint() transaction so it is mined first in the same block (asm_attacker_can_frontrun).
The epoch window is open at the time the keeper submits checkpoint().

unresolved.description: Report does not specify the exact epoch window duration or the checkpoint() guard beyond the same-block latch; the open-window condition is represented as a grounded Boolean.

limitations: Only the direct impact i_checkpoint_reverts is formalized; i_epoch_delay, i_cascading_delays and i_indefinite_dos are deferred to future claims.
The front-running capability is treated as an assumption, not as a precondition of the safety relation.
The same-block equality between lastDonationBlockNumber and the checkpoint block is the report-grounded trigger; the latch mechanism itself is root cause, not P.
